brief:
Palestinian children in Gaza are suffering permanent developmental harm from malnutrition caused by Israel's restrictions on food supplies, Middle East Eye reported. Ten-year-old Mohammed and other children face lasting growth problems and lack access to specialist medical care needed to address their conditions.

The famine has affected infants and young children during critical periods of physical and cognitive development, leaving them with health complications that persist even as conditions improve. Palestinian families in Gaza struggle to obtain the specialized treatment required to help malnourished children recover from the long-term effects of extended food scarcity. Medical experts warn that damage sustained during early childhood development may prove irreversible without sustained intervention.

title: Israel's Gaza blockade leaves children with stunted growth and developmental damage
